meta.title: Cinder — a wood-fired restaurant
meta.description: A neighbourhood restaurant with a kitchen loop behind the name, tonight's menu as a priced ledger, a poster of the fire, the room, hours beside a map, the full menu by course, the people and the farms, and a booking form. Built from a gogh site definition with Unsplash pictures and a Mixkit loop.
meta.author: jamiemarsland
